verdict.rationale: Luma publishes credit-based pricing with per-model, per-resolution credit costs (e.g. 360p Draft 5s T2V/I2V = 20 credits) and pay-per-video API pricing. That gives a marketer a way to work out a generation's cost before running it, but only from a price table. Nothing shows an in-product cost estimate at generation time, and nothing covers tracking spend afterwards. Missing for 10: an in-app pre-run cost or credit preview, a usage/spend dashboard or history, a dollar conversion of credits, and independent corroboration.
